actionType.description:
ActionType: "TRANSACTION_CREATED", "BUDGET_ALERT", "FINANCIAL_SUMMARY", "KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE",
"PENDING_CONFIRMATION" (AI write proposal; data has actionId, toolName,
kind, status PENDING|CONFIRMED|CANCELLED|EXPIRED, expiresAt, amount,
type, categoryName, walletName, date, description, resultCard).

expiresIn.description: ExpiresIn is the access token lifetime in seconds.

actionCard.description:
ActionCard is the card of the executed action (e.g. TRANSACTION_CREATED
with the new transaction id), only on confirm.

result.description: Result is the created/updated entity returned by the tool, only on confirm.

toolResults.description: ToolResults is a JSON array of the ActionCards shown with this message.

maxExpense.description: Highest single-day expense, for color scaling

count.description: Number of transactions that day (all types)

investment.description: Investment is the amount invested that day (INVESTMENT of any status)

expiresIn.description: ExpiresIn is the access token lifetime in seconds.

investment.description:
Investment is the month's active (HOLDING) investment, the same
definition as /reports/summary totalInvestment.

change.description: Change = Income − Expense + RealizedPnL for the month.

current.description: Current is the last item's NetWorth.

opening.description: Opening is net worth just before the first item's month.

model.description:
Model must be one of GET /chat/models; any other value is ignored and
the server default is used.

lastUsed.description: latest transaction date with this tag

expiresIn.description: ExpiresIn is the access token lifetime in seconds.

baseCurrency.description: BaseCurrency is the currency of TotalBalance.

totalBalance.description: TotalBalance sums only wallets in BaseCurrency (VND) that are included in total.

totalsByCurrency.description: TotalsByCurrency sums included wallets per currency (no FX conversion).
